Mulai ulang dsh untuk memuatnya. **Pengaturan → Composer Plus → Pembaruan Composer Plus** menampilkan versi dan memiliki **Periksa pembaruan** / **Perbarui sekarang**. Saat dsh pertama kali dimulai dengan versi baru, jendela **Yang baru di Composer Plus N** menampilkan catatan rilis versi itu satu kali (dari pemeriksaan pembaruan yang sama, tanpa panggilan jaringan lain); **Tutup** atau `Esc` menutupnya.
how.vi: Khi dsh khởi động, plugin kiểm tra [bản phát hành GitHub mới nhất](https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus/releases/latest). Nếu bản đó mới hơn và đã có trên npm, plugin cài đúng phiên bản đó qua trình quản lý plugin của chính dsh (cùng cách với Cài đặt → Plugin) và thông báo cho bạn. Khởi động lại dsh để tải bản mới. **Cài đặt → Composer Plus → Cập nhật Composer Plus** hiện phiên bản và có nút **Kiểm tra cập nhật** / **Cập nhật ngay**. Lần đầu dsh khởi động với phiên bản mới, cửa sổ **Có gì mới trong Composer Plus N** hiện ghi chú phát hành của phiên bản đó một lần (lấy từ chính lần kiểm tra cập nhật, không gọi mạng thêm); **Đóng** hoặc `Esc` đóng nó.
how.hi: dsh शुरू होने पर प्लगइन [GitHub की नवीनतम रिलीज़](https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus/releases/latest) जांचता है। अगर वह नई है और npm पर पहले से है, तो प्लगइन वही वर्शन dsh के अपने प्लगइन मैनेजर से इंस्टॉल करता है (सेटिंग → प्लगइन वाला ही रास्ता) और आपको सूचित करता है। इसे लोड करने के लिए dsh रीस्टार्ट करें। **सेटिंग → Composer Plus → Composer Plus अपडेट** वर्शन दिखाता है और उसमें **अपडेट जांचें** / **अभी अपडेट करें** बटन हैं। नए वर्शन के साथ dsh पहली बार शुरू होने पर **Composer Plus N में नया क्या है** विंडो उस वर्शन के रिलीज़ नोट्स एक बार दिखाती है (उसी अपडेट जांच से, कोई अतिरिक्त नेटवर्क कॉल नहीं); **बंद करें** या `Esc` से यह बंद होती है।

features.llms: On by default (nothing runs without a click). Settings → Composer Plus → Backup: Back up now writes the whole dsh home into ~/Desktop/dsh-backups/dsh-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSmmm>.tar.gz (gzip tar, one top folder) with .sha256, .meta.json and .redacted.json; the format and folder are the same as dsh-backup 0.13, so its archives stay usable. cache/, dsh-runtimes/, every node_modules and .system are not archived. Masked (not in the archive, the real copy only in composer-plus-vault/<archive>/ of the backup folder, 0600; dsh-backup archives read their secrets from its vault/ mirror): .credentials.yaml, .env and .env.*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx, qq-bridge/config.json, and in every .yml/.yaml file (also cordis.patch.yml.bak-…) the values (one line, plain or block scalar) of keys whose last word is token, secret, password, passphrase, credential(s), authorization, apiKey, accessKey, secretKey, privateKey, clientSecret, authKey or authToken (maxTokens and apiKeyEnv stay). Symbolic links are archived as links and never followed; FIFOs, sockets and devices are skipped; files are read with O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK. Per archive: Check (reads it fully, checksum, safe names), For another computer (a transfer-<time> folder with the archive, its sidecars and the rescue console, no vault: secrets are entered again there), Delete (also its vault copies). One backup action at a time (also against the rescue console: a lock file in the folder). Restore is not in dsh: quit dsh and use the rescue console. Not in Tether.

how.en: Settings → Composer Plus → **Backup** → **Back up now** writes your whole dsh home (chats, settings, plugins, MCP, skills) into one archive in `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, with a checksum. Secrets are masked in the archive: credential files, key files (`.pem`, `.key`) and the token, secret and password values of the yml settings stay on this computer only, in the folder's `vault`. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` and `node_modules` are not archived (dsh makes them again). Each backup in the list has **Check** (reads it fully), **For another computer** (a folder to copy to the new computer, with the rescue console) and **Delete**. dsh-backup's archives in the same folder show and work too. To restore, quit dsh and use the rescue console.
how.zh: 设置 → Composer Plus → **备份** → **立即备份**：把整个 dsh 主目录（对话、设置、插件、MCP、技能）连同校验和写成 `~/Desktop/dsh-backups` 中的一个归档。归档中的机密会被遮蔽：凭据文件、密钥文件（`.pem`、`.key`）以及 yml 设置中的 token、secret 和 password 值只保存在这台电脑上，位于该文件夹的 `vault` 中。`cache/`、`dsh-runtimes/` 和 `node_modules` 不会归档（dsh 会重新生成它们）。列表中的每份备份都有 **检查**（完整读取）、**用于另一台电脑**（一个可复制到新电脑的文件夹，含救援控制台）和 **删除**。同一文件夹中 dsh-backup 的归档也会显示并可使用。要恢复，请退出 dsh 并使用救援控制台。
how.tr: Ayarlar → Composer Plus → **Yedekleme** → **Şimdi yedekle**, dsh ana klasörünüzün tamamını (sohbetler, ayarlar, eklentiler, MCP, beceriler) sağlama toplamıyla birlikte `~/Desktop/dsh-backups` içindeki tek bir arşive yazar. Gizli bilgiler arşivde maskelenir: kimlik bilgisi dosyaları, anahtar dosyaları (`.pem`, `.key`) ve yml ayarlarındaki token, secret ve password değerleri yalnızca bu bilgisayarda, klasördeki `vault` içinde kalır. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` ve `node_modules` arşive girmez (dsh bunları yeniden oluşturur). Listedeki her yedekte **Kontrol et** (yedeği baştan sona okur), **Başka bir bilgisayar için** (yeni bilgisayara kopyalanacak, kurtarma konsolunu da içeren bir klasör) ve **Sil** vardır. Aynı klasördeki dsh-backup arşivleri de listede görünür ve kullanılabilir. Geri yüklemek için dsh’den çıkın ve kurtarma konsolunu kullanın.
how.es: Configuración → Composer Plus → **Copia de seguridad** → **Hacer copia ahora** guarda todo tu directorio home de dsh (chats, ajustes, plugins, MCP, skills) en un único archivo comprimido en `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, con una suma de comprobación. Los secretos se ocultan en el archivo comprimido: los archivos de credenciales, los archivos de claves (`.pem`, `.key`) y los valores token, secret y password de los ajustes yml se quedan solo en este equipo, en el `vault` de la carpeta. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` y `node_modules` no entran en el archivo comprimido (dsh los vuelve a crear). Cada copia de seguridad de la lista tiene **Comprobar** (la lee completa), **Para otro equipo** (una carpeta para copiar al equipo nuevo, con la consola de rescate) y **Eliminar**. Los archivos comprimidos de dsh-backup en la misma carpeta también aparecen y funcionan. Para restaurar, sal de dsh y usa la consola de rescate.
how.pt-BR: Configurações → Composer Plus → **Backup** → **Fazer backup agora** grava toda a sua pasta home do dsh (chats, configurações, plugins, MCP, skills) em um único arquivo compactado em `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, com checksum. Os segredos ficam mascarados no arquivo compactado: arquivos de credenciais, arquivos de chave (`.pem`, `.key`) e os valores token, secret e password das configurações yml ficam só neste computador, no `vault` da pasta. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` e `node_modules` não entram no arquivo compactado (o dsh os cria de novo). Cada backup da lista tem **Verificar** (lê o backup inteiro), **Para outro computador** (uma pasta para copiar para o novo computador, com o console de resgate) e **Excluir**. Os arquivos compactados do dsh-backup na mesma pasta também aparecem e funcionam. Para restaurar, saia do dsh e use o console de resgate.
how.fr: Réglages → Composer Plus → **Sauvegarde** → **Sauvegarder maintenant** écrit tout votre dossier personnel de dsh (discussions, réglages, plugins, MCP, compétences) dans une seule archive dans `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, avec une somme de contrôle. Les secrets sont masqués dans l’archive : les fichiers d’identifiants, les fichiers de clés (`.pem`, `.key`) et les valeurs token, secret et password des réglages yml restent uniquement sur cet ordinateur, dans le `vault` du dossier. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` et `node_modules` ne vont pas dans l’archive (dsh les recrée). Chaque sauvegarde de la liste a **Vérifier** (la lit entièrement), **Pour un autre ordinateur** (un dossier à copier sur le nouvel ordinateur, avec la console de secours) et **Supprimer**. Les archives de dsh-backup dans le même dossier s’affichent et fonctionnent aussi. Pour restaurer, quittez dsh et utilisez la console de secours.
how.de: Einstellungen → Composer Plus → **Sicherung** → **Jetzt sichern** schreibt dein ganzes dsh-Home (Chats, Einstellungen, Plugins, MCP, Skills) mit Prüfsumme in ein einziges Archiv in `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`. Geheimnisse werden im Archiv maskiert: Dateien mit Anmeldedaten, Schlüsseldateien (`.pem`, `.key`) und die Werte token, secret und password der yml-Einstellungen bleiben nur auf diesem Computer, im `vault` des Ordners. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` und `node_modules` kommen nicht ins Archiv (dsh erstellt sie neu). Jede Sicherung in der Liste hat **Prüfen** (liest sie vollständig), **Für einen anderen Computer** (ein Ordner zum Kopieren auf den neuen Computer, mit der Rettungskonsole) und **Löschen**. Archive von dsh-backup im selben Ordner erscheinen und funktionieren auch. Zum Wiederherstellen beende dsh und nutze die Rettungskonsole.
how.ru: Настройки → Composer Plus → **Резервное копирование** → **Создать копию сейчас** записывает всю домашнюю папку dsh (чаты, настройки, плагины, MCP, навыки) в один архив в `~/Desktop/dsh-backups` вместе с контрольной суммой. Секреты в архиве скрыты: файлы учётных данных, файлы ключей (`.pem`, `.key`) и значения token, secret и password в настройках yml остаются только на этом компьютере, в `vault` этой папки. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` и `node_modules` в архив не входят (dsh создаёт их заново). У каждой резервной копии в списке есть **Проверить** (читает её целиком), **Для другого компьютера** (папка для копирования на новый компьютер, вместе с аварийной консолью) и **Удалить**. Архивы dsh-backup в той же папке тоже показываются и работают. Чтобы восстановить данные, выйдите из dsh и используйте аварийную консоль.
how.ja: 設定 → Composer Plus → **バックアップ** → **今すぐバックアップ** で、dsh のホーム全体（チャット、設定、プラグイン、MCP、スキル）を、チェックサム付きで `~/Desktop/dsh-backups` 内の 1 つのアーカイブに書き込みます。アーカイブ内のシークレットはマスクされます。認証情報ファイル、鍵ファイル（`.pem`、`.key`）、yml 設定の token、secret、password の値は、このコンピュータ上のフォルダーの `vault` にだけ残ります。`cache/`、`dsh-runtimes/`、`node_modules` はアーカイブに入りません（dsh が作り直します）。一覧の各バックアップには、**チェック**（全体を読み取ります）、**別のコンピュータ用**（新しいコンピュータにコピーするフォルダーで、レスキューコンソールを含みます）、**削除** があります。同じフォルダーにある dsh-backup のアーカイブも表示され、使えます。復元するには、dsh を終了してレスキューコンソールを使います。
how.ko: 설정 → Composer Plus → **백업** → **지금 백업**은 dsh 홈 전체(채팅, 설정, 플러그인, MCP, 스킬)를 체크섬과 함께 `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`의 아카이브 하나에 씁니다. 아카이브에서 비밀 값은 마스킹됩니다. 자격 증명 파일, 키 파일(`.pem`, `.key`), yml 설정의 token, secret, password 값은 이 컴퓨터에만, 폴더의 `vault`에 남습니다. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/`, `node_modules`는 아카이브에 들어가지 않습니다(dsh가 다시 만듭니다). 목록의 각 백업에는 **검사**(끝까지 읽음), **다른 컴퓨터용**(새 컴퓨터로 복사할 폴더, 복구 콘솔 포함), **삭제**가 있습니다. 같은 폴더에 있는 dsh-backup의 아카이브도 표시되고 사용할 수 있습니다. 복원하려면 dsh를 종료하고 복구 콘솔을 사용하세요.
how.id: Pengaturan → Composer Plus → **Pencadangan** → **Cadangkan sekarang** menulis seluruh dsh home Anda (obrolan, pengaturan, plugin, MCP, skill) ke dalam satu arsip di `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, beserta checksum. Rahasia disamarkan di dalam arsip: file kredensial, file kunci (`.pem`, `.key`), serta nilai token, secret, dan password di pengaturan yml hanya tetap ada di komputer ini, di `vault` folder tersebut. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/`, dan `node_modules` tidak masuk ke arsip (dsh membuatnya lagi). Setiap cadangan dalam daftar memiliki **Periksa** (membacanya sampai habis), **Untuk komputer lain** (folder untuk disalin ke komputer baru, beserta konsol penyelamat), dan **Hapus**. Arsip dsh-backup di folder yang sama juga tampil dan dapat dipakai. Untuk memulihkan, keluar dari dsh dan gunakan konsol penyelamat.
how.vi: Cài đặt → Composer Plus → **Sao lưu** → **Sao lưu ngay** ghi toàn bộ thư mục home của dsh (cuộc trò chuyện, cài đặt, plugin, MCP, skill) vào một tệp lưu trữ duy nhất trong `~/Desktop/dsh-backups`, kèm checksum. Thông tin bí mật được che trong tệp lưu trữ: các tệp thông tin xác thực, tệp khóa (`.pem`, `.key`) và các giá trị token, secret và password trong cài đặt yml chỉ ở lại trên máy tính này, trong `vault` của thư mục. `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` và `node_modules` không có trong tệp lưu trữ (dsh tạo lại chúng). Mỗi bản sao lưu trong danh sách có **Kiểm tra** (đọc hết bản sao lưu), **Cho máy tính khác** (một thư mục để sao chép sang máy tính mới, kèm bảng điều khiển cứu hộ) và **Xóa**. Các tệp lưu trữ của dsh-backup trong cùng thư mục cũng hiện ra và dùng được. Để khôi phục, hãy thoát dsh và dùng bảng điều khiển cứu hộ.
how.hi: सेटिंग → Composer Plus → **बैकअप** → **अभी बैकअप लें** आपके पूरे dsh होम (चैट, सेटिंग, प्लगइन, MCP, Skills) को चेकसम के साथ `~/Desktop/dsh-backups` में एक आर्काइव में लिखता है। आर्काइव में सीक्रेट मास्क किए जाते हैं: क्रेडेंशियल फ़ाइलें, की फ़ाइलें (`.pem`, `.key`) और yml सेटिंग के token, secret और password मान सिर्फ़ इसी कंप्यूटर पर, फ़ोल्डर के `vault` में रहते हैं। `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` और `node_modules` आर्काइव में नहीं जाते (dsh उन्हें फिर से बनाता है)। सूची के हर बैकअप में **जांचें** (उसे पूरा पढ़ता है), **दूसरे कंप्यूटर के लिए** (नए कंप्यूटर पर कॉपी करने के लिए एक फ़ोल्डर, रेस्क्यू कंसोल के साथ) और **हटाएं** हैं। उसी फ़ोल्डर में dsh-backup के आर्काइव भी दिखते हैं और काम करते हैं। बहाल करने के लिए dsh बंद करें और रेस्क्यू कंसोल का उपयोग करें।

features.llms: Off by default (each copy is about the size of the dsh home without its cache; the Host keeps the switch in auto-backup.json). When on, the Host backs up every 6, 12, 24 (default), 72 or 168 hours, counted from the newest full backup in the folder (also a manual one), and keeps the newest 3, 5, 7 (default) or 14 of its own automatic backups (Back up now deletes nothing; dsh-backup archives are never deleted); never in the first 45 s after a start. When dsh or Composer Plus starts with another version than at the last start, it first takes a dsh-pre-upgrade-<time> snapshot (the newest 2 stay). A failed backup shows in Settings and the next try waits 30 minutes (or the interval when shorter). Not in Tether.

how.en: Switch on **Automatic backup** (off by default: each copy is about as large as your dsh home without its cache). Choose how often (**Every**: 6 hours to 7 days, 24 hours by default) and how many backups stay (**Keep**: 3 to 14, 7 by default). The next time shows under the switch; a failed backup shows there too and is tried again 30 minutes later. When dsh or Composer Plus starts with a new version, a snapshot comes soon after the start, before the new version has used your data for long (the two newest stay, marked **Before an upgrade**).
how.zh: 打开 **自动备份**（默认关闭：每份大约与不含缓存的 dsh 主目录一样大）。选择频率（**每**：6 小时到 7 天，默认 24 小时）和保留的份数（**保留**：3 到 14 份，默认 7 份）。下次备份时间显示在开关下方；失败的备份也会显示在那里，并在 30 分钟后重试。dsh 或 Composer Plus 以新版本启动时，会在启动后不久、新版本长时间使用你的数据之前拍一份快照（保留最新的两份，标记为 **升级前**）。
how.tr: **Otomatik yedekleme** özelliğini açın (varsayılan olarak kapalıdır: her kopya, önbelleği hariç dsh ana klasörünüz kadar yer kaplar). Ne sıklıkla yedekleneceğini (**Sıklık**: 6 saatten 7 güne kadar, varsayılan 24 saat) ve kaç yedeğin saklanacağını (**Sakla**: 3 ile 14 arası, varsayılan 7) seçin. Sonraki yedekleme zamanı anahtarın altında görünür. Başarısız bir yedekleme de orada görünür ve 30 dakika sonra yeniden denenir. dsh ya da Composer Plus yeni bir sürümle açıldığında, açılıştan kısa süre sonra, yeni sürüm verilerinizi uzun süre kullanmadan önce bir anlık görüntü alınır (en yeni ikisi saklanır ve **Yükseltmeden önce** olarak işaretlenir).
how.es: Activa **Copia de seguridad automática** (desactivada de forma predeterminada: cada copia ocupa más o menos lo mismo que tu directorio home de dsh sin su caché). Elige la frecuencia (**Cada**: de 6 horas a 7 días, 24 horas de forma predeterminada) y cuántas copias de seguridad se conservan (**Conservar**: de 3 a 14, 7 de forma predeterminada). La hora de la próxima copia aparece bajo el interruptor; una copia fallida también aparece allí y se vuelve a intentar 30 minutos después. Cuando dsh o Composer Plus se inicia con una versión nueva, se toma una instantánea poco después del inicio, antes de que la versión nueva haya usado tus datos mucho tiempo (se conservan las dos más recientes, marcadas como **Antes de una actualización**).
how.pt-BR: Ative **Backup automático** (desativado por padrão: cada cópia tem mais ou menos o tamanho da sua pasta home do dsh sem o cache). Escolha a frequência (**A cada**: de 6 horas a 7 dias, 24 horas por padrão) e quantos backups ficam guardados (**Manter**: de 3 a 14, 7 por padrão). O horário do próximo backup aparece abaixo da chave; um backup que falhou também aparece ali e é tentado de novo 30 minutos depois. Quando o dsh ou o Composer Plus inicia com uma nova versão, um snapshot é feito logo após o início, antes que a nova versão use seus dados por muito tempo (os dois mais recentes ficam guardados, marcados como **Antes de uma atualização**).
how.fr: Activez **Sauvegarde automatique** (désactivée par défaut : chaque copie est à peu près aussi grande que votre dossier personnel de dsh sans son cache). Choisissez la fréquence (**Toutes les** : de 6 heures à 7 jours, 24 heures par défaut) et le nombre de sauvegardes conservées (**Conserver** : de 3 à 14, 7 par défaut). L’heure de la prochaine sauvegarde s’affiche sous l’interrupteur ; une sauvegarde qui a échoué s’y affiche aussi et est relancée 30 minutes plus tard. Quand dsh ou Composer Plus démarre avec une nouvelle version, un instantané est pris peu après le démarrage, avant que la nouvelle version ait longtemps utilisé vos données (les deux plus récents restent, marqués **Avant une mise à niveau**).
how.de: Schalte **Automatische Sicherung** ein (standardmäßig aus: Jede Kopie ist etwa so groß wie dein dsh-Home ohne seinen Cache). Wähle, wie oft gesichert wird (**Alle**: 6 Stunden bis 7 Tage, standardmäßig 24 Stunden) und wie viele Sicherungen bleiben (**Behalten**: 3 bis 14, standardmäßig 7). Der nächste Zeitpunkt steht unter dem Schalter; eine fehlgeschlagene Sicherung erscheint dort auch und wird 30 Minuten später erneut versucht. Wenn dsh oder Composer Plus mit einer neuen Version startet, entsteht kurz nach dem Start ein Snapshot, bevor die neue Version deine Daten lange benutzt hat (die zwei neuesten bleiben, markiert mit **Vor einem Upgrade**).
how.ru: Включите **Автоматическое резервное копирование** (по умолчанию выключено: каждая копия занимает примерно столько же места, сколько ваша домашняя папка dsh без кеша). Выберите, как часто создавать копии (**Каждые**: от 6 часов до 7 дней, по умолчанию 24 часа), и сколько резервных копий хранить (**Хранить**: от 3 до 14, по умолчанию 7). Время следующей копии показано под переключателем; неудачная копия тоже показывается там, и через 30 минут будет новая попытка. Когда dsh или Composer Plus запускается с новой версией, вскоре после запуска создаётся снимок, пока новая версия ещё недолго работала с вашими данными (хранятся два самых новых, с пометкой **Перед обновлением**).
how.ja: **自動バックアップ** をオンにします（既定ではオフです。各コピーは、キャッシュを除いた dsh のホームとほぼ同じ大きさになります）。頻度（**間隔**：6 時間から 7 日、既定は 24 時間）と、残すバックアップの数（**保持**：3 から 14、既定は 7）を選びます。次回の時刻はスイッチの下に表示されます。失敗したバックアップもそこに表示され、30 分後に再試行されます。dsh または Composer Plus が新しいバージョンで起動すると、起動後まもなく、新しいバージョンがデータを長く使う前にスナップショットを作成します（最新の 2 つが残り、**アップグレード前** と表示されます）。
how.ko: **자동 백업**을 켜세요(기본적으로 꺼져 있습니다. 각 사본은 캐시를 뺀 dsh 홈과 크기가 거의 같습니다). 얼마나 자주 백업할지(**간격**: 6시간에서 7일, 기본값 24시간)와 백업을 몇 개 남길지(**보관**: 3에서 14, 기본값 7)를 고르세요. 다음 백업 시각은 스위치 아래에 표시됩니다. 실패한 백업도 그곳에 표시되고, 30분 뒤에 다시 시도합니다. dsh나 Composer Plus가 새 버전으로 시작하면, 시작 직후 새 버전이 데이터를 오래 쓰기 전에 스냅샷을 만듭니다(가장 최신 두 개가 남고, **업그레이드 전**으로 표시됩니다).
how.id: Aktifkan **Pencadangan otomatis** (nonaktif secara default: setiap salinan kira-kira sebesar dsh home Anda tanpa cache-nya). Pilih seberapa sering (**Setiap**: 6 jam sampai 7 hari, default 24 jam) dan berapa banyak cadangan yang disimpan (**Simpan**: 3 sampai 14, default 7). Waktu berikutnya tampil di bawah sakelar; pencadangan yang gagal juga tampil di sana dan dicoba lagi 30 menit kemudian. Saat dsh atau Composer Plus dimulai dengan versi baru, snapshot dibuat segera setelah dimulai, sebelum versi baru lama memakai data Anda (dua yang terbaru disimpan, ditandai **Sebelum peningkatan**).
how.vi: Bật **Tự động sao lưu** (mặc định tắt: mỗi bản sao có dung lượng gần bằng thư mục home của dsh khi không tính bộ nhớ đệm). Chọn tần suất (**Mỗi**: từ 6 giờ đến 7 ngày, mặc định 24 giờ) và số bản sao lưu được giữ (**Giữ**: từ 3 đến 14, mặc định 7). Thời điểm tiếp theo hiện bên dưới công tắc; một lần sao lưu thất bại cũng hiện ở đó và được thử lại sau 30 phút. Khi dsh hoặc Composer Plus khởi động với phiên bản mới, một snapshot được tạo ngay sau khi khởi động, trước khi phiên bản mới dùng dữ liệu của bạn lâu (hai bản mới nhất được giữ, đánh dấu **Trước khi nâng cấp**).
how.hi: **अपने-आप बैकअप** चालू करें (डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से बंद: हर कॉपी लगभग उतनी बड़ी होती है जितना कैश के बिना आपका dsh होम)। चुनें कि बैकअप कितनी बार हो (**हर**: 6 घंटे से 7 दिन, डिफ़ॉल्ट 24 घंटे) और कितने बैकअप रखे जाएं (**रखें**: 3 से 14, डिफ़ॉल्ट 7)। अगला समय स्विच के नीचे दिखता है; विफल बैकअप भी वहीं दिखता है और 30 मिनट बाद फिर से आज़माया जाता है। जब dsh या Composer Plus नए वर्शन के साथ शुरू होता है, तो शुरू होने के कुछ ही देर बाद, नए वर्शन के आपके डेटा का लंबे समय तक उपयोग करने से पहले, एक स्नैपशॉट लिया जाता है (सबसे नए दो रखे जाते हैं, **अपग्रेड से पहले** के निशान के साथ)।

features.llms: On by default (runs only on a click). Settings → Composer Plus → Session log check → Check session logs reads the newest log of every chat under sessions/ (session[.vN].jsonl[.zstd]): zstd frames with dsh's own rules (a torn last frame is not damage: dsh cuts it at its next write), the first frame must be exactly the header line, no record may end inside a complete frame, and a row that is not JSON or (v4) has a seq other than its place is damage only when a turn/end row follows it (dsh's own recoverable rule; otherwise dsh opens the rows before it). Repair from backups checks again, then puts back each damaged log of a chat that is not open in this dsh from the newest archive that has a healthy copy; the damaged file stays as <name>.corrupt-<time>. Messages after that backup are not in the copy. Open chats: the rescue console, with dsh closed. Not in Tether.

how.en: **Check session logs** reads every chat's log and lists the ones that dsh cannot open (a broken frame, a cut record, a wrong sequence number). A torn tail is not listed: dsh repairs it itself. **Repair from backups** puts back the copy from the newest backup that has a healthy one and keeps the damaged file next to it (`.corrupt-<time>`). Messages written after that backup are not in the copy. A chat that is open in this dsh is not repaired here: quit dsh and repair it in the rescue console.
how.zh: **检查会话日志** 会读取每个对话的日志，并列出 dsh 无法打开的日志（帧损坏、记录被截断、序号错误）。尾部撕裂的日志不会列出：dsh 会自行修复。**从备份修复** 会放回最新一份含有健康副本的备份中的副本，并把损坏的文件保留在旁边（`.corrupt-<时间>`）。该备份之后写入的消息不在副本中。在此 dsh 中打开的对话不会在这里修复：请退出 dsh，在救援控制台中修复。
how.tr: **Oturum günlüklerini kontrol et**, her sohbetin günlüğünü okur ve dsh’nin açamadığı günlükleri listeler (bozuk bir çerçeve, kesik bir kayıt, yanlış bir sıra numarası). Sonu yarım kalmış bir günlük listelenmez: dsh onu kendisi onarır. **Yedeklerden onar**, sağlam kopyası olan en yeni yedekteki kopyayı geri koyar ve hasarlı dosyayı yanında saklar (`.corrupt-<zaman>`). O yedekten sonra yazılan mesajlar kopyada yoktur. Bu dsh’de açık olan bir sohbet burada onarılmaz: dsh’den çıkın ve sohbeti kurtarma konsolunda onarın.
how.es: **Comprobar registros de sesión** lee el registro de cada chat y muestra los que dsh no puede abrir (un bloque roto, una entrada cortada, un número de secuencia incorrecto). Un final incompleto no aparece en la lista: dsh lo repara por sí mismo. **Reparar desde copias de seguridad** vuelve a poner la copia de la copia de seguridad más reciente que tenga una versión sana y guarda el archivo dañado a su lado (`.corrupt-<hora>`). Los mensajes escritos después de esa copia de seguridad no están en la copia. Un chat abierto en este dsh no se repara aquí: sal de dsh y repáralo en la consola de rescate.
how.pt-BR: **Verificar logs de sessão** lê o log de cada chat e lista os que o dsh não consegue abrir (um frame quebrado, um registro cortado, um número de sequência errado). Um final incompleto não entra na lista: o próprio dsh o repara. **Reparar a partir dos backups** coloca de volta a cópia do backup mais recente que tenha uma cópia íntegra e mantém o arquivo danificado ao lado dela (`.corrupt-<hora>`). As mensagens escritas depois desse backup não estão na cópia. Um chat aberto neste dsh não é reparado aqui: saia do dsh e repare-o no console de resgate.
how.fr: **Vérifier les journaux de session** lit le journal de chaque discussion et liste ceux que dsh ne peut pas ouvrir (une trame cassée, un enregistrement coupé, un mauvais numéro de séquence). Une fin incomplète n’est pas listée : dsh la répare lui-même. **Réparer depuis les sauvegardes** remet la copie de la sauvegarde la plus récente qui en contient une saine et garde le fichier endommagé à côté (`.corrupt-<heure>`). Les messages écrits après cette sauvegarde ne sont pas dans la copie. Une discussion ouverte dans ce dsh n’est pas réparée ici : quittez dsh et réparez-la dans la console de secours.
how.de: **Sitzungsprotokolle prüfen** liest das Protokoll jedes Chats und listet die auf, die dsh nicht öffnen kann (ein defekter Frame, ein abgeschnittener Datensatz, eine falsche Sequenznummer). Ein abgerissenes Ende wird nicht aufgelistet: dsh repariert es selbst. **Aus Sicherungen reparieren** legt die Kopie aus der neuesten Sicherung zurück, die eine intakte Kopie enthält, und behält die beschädigte Datei daneben (`.corrupt-<Zeit>`). Nachrichten, die nach dieser Sicherung geschrieben wurden, sind nicht in der Kopie. Ein Chat, der in diesem dsh offen ist, wird hier nicht repariert: Beende dsh und repariere ihn in der Rettungskonsole.
how.ru: **Проверить журналы сеансов** читает журнал каждого чата и показывает те, которые dsh не может открыть (повреждённый фрейм, обрезанная запись, неверный порядковый номер). Оборванный конец журнала в список не попадает: dsh исправляет его сам. **Исправить из резервных копий** возвращает копию из самой новой резервной копии, где она не повреждена, и оставляет повреждённый файл рядом (`.corrupt-<время>`). Сообщений, написанных после этой резервной копии, в копии нет. Чат, открытый в этом dsh, здесь не исправляется: выйдите из dsh и исправьте его в аварийной консоли.
how.ja: **セッションログをチェック** は、すべてのチャットのログを読み取り、dsh が開けないログ（壊れたフレーム、途切れたレコード、誤ったシーケンス番号）を一覧表示します。末尾だけが欠けたログは一覧に出ません。dsh が自分で修復します。**バックアップから修復** は、正常なコピーがある最新のバックアップからコピーを戻し、損傷したファイルをその隣に残します（`.corrupt-<時刻>`）。そのバックアップ以降に書かれたメッセージはコピーに含まれません。この dsh で開いているチャットはここでは修復されません。dsh を終了して、レスキューコンソールで修復してください。
how.ko: **세션 로그 검사**는 모든 채팅의 로그를 읽고, dsh가 열 수 없는 로그를 나열합니다(깨진 프레임, 잘린 레코드, 잘못된 시퀀스 번호). 마지막 부분만 덜 쓰인 로그는 나열되지 않습니다. dsh가 직접 고칩니다. **백업에서 복구**는 정상 사본이 있는 가장 최신 백업에서 사본을 되돌려 놓고, 손상된 파일은 그 옆에 보관합니다(`.corrupt-<시각>`). 그 백업 이후에 작성된 메시지는 사본에 없습니다. 이 dsh에서 열려 있는 채팅은 여기서 복구되지 않습니다. dsh를 종료하고 복구 콘솔에서 복구하세요.
how.id: **Periksa log sesi** membaca log setiap obrolan dan menampilkan log yang tidak dapat dibuka dsh (frame rusak, catatan terpotong, nomor urut salah). Bagian akhir yang tidak lengkap tidak ditampilkan: dsh memperbaikinya sendiri. **Perbaiki dari cadangan** mengembalikan salinan dari cadangan terbaru yang memiliki salinan sehat, dan menyimpan file yang rusak di sebelahnya (`.corrupt-<waktu>`). Pesan yang ditulis setelah cadangan itu tidak ada di salinan. Obrolan yang terbuka di dsh ini tidak diperbaiki di sini: keluar dari dsh dan perbaiki obrolan itu di konsol penyelamat.
how.vi: **Kiểm tra nhật ký phiên** đọc nhật ký của mọi cuộc trò chuyện và liệt kê những nhật ký mà dsh không mở được (frame bị hỏng, bản ghi bị cắt, số thứ tự sai). Phần cuối bị dở dang không được liệt kê: dsh tự sửa phần đó. **Sửa từ bản sao lưu** đưa bản sao từ bản sao lưu mới nhất có bản còn tốt trở lại, và giữ tệp bị hỏng ngay bên cạnh (`.corrupt-<thời gian>`). Các tin nhắn viết sau bản sao lưu đó không có trong bản sao. Cuộc trò chuyện đang mở trong dsh này không được sửa ở đây: hãy thoát dsh và sửa nó trong bảng điều khiển cứu hộ.
how.hi: **सेशन लॉग जांचें** हर चैट का लॉग पढ़ता है और उन लॉग की सूची दिखाता है जिन्हें dsh नहीं खोल सकता (टूटा फ़्रेम, कटा हुआ रिकॉर्ड, गलत क्रम संख्या)। अधूरा आखिरी हिस्सा सूची में नहीं आता: dsh उसे खुद ठीक करता है। **बैकअप से ठीक करें** उस सबसे नए बैकअप से कॉपी वापस रखता है जिसमें सही कॉपी है, और खराब फ़ाइल को उसके बगल में रखता है (`.corrupt-<समय>`)। उस बैकअप के बाद लिखे गए संदेश कॉपी में नहीं होते। इस dsh में खुली चैट यहां ठीक नहीं की जाती: dsh बंद करें और उसे रेस्क्यू कंसोल में ठीक करें।

features.llms: On by default (the Host keeps the switch in rescue-console.json). Each backup writes composer-plus-rescue.mjs (the same backup.mjs, Node standard library only) and a launcher (macOS: Composer Plus Rescue.command, Linux: composer-plus-rescue.sh, Windows: Composer Plus Rescue.cmd) into the backup folder; a start replaces a copy that is there. The launcher finds Node.js 18 or later on PATH, Homebrew, nvm or dsh's own runtime, else runs the DeepSeek Harness app as Node.js (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1). A terminal menu, no network port: list backups, check one, restore one, check session logs, repair them. Restore and repair refuse while dsh runs (storages/dsh-composer-plus/running/host-<pid>.json of a live process; each dsh process has its own), checks the archive, asks to type RESTORE, writes it into a new folder next to the dsh home (files O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW, symbolic links last and never followed, no entry below a link, no devices), puts the masked files back from the vault (composer-plus-vault/<archive>/, or dsh-backup's vault/ mirror for its archives), swaps the folders (the old home stays as <home>.pre-restore-<time>), moves cache/, dsh-runtimes/ and node_modules over from it, and offers pnpm install for profiles that need it. Switched off, the files are removed. Not in Tether.

how.en: Each backup also puts a rescue console into the backup folder. When dsh is closed or does not start, open `Composer Plus Rescue` in that folder (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): a menu in a terminal window lists, checks and restores backups and checks and repairs session logs. It opens no network port. A restore asks you to type `RESTORE`, keeps your current dsh home as `.dsh.pre-restore-<time>`, puts the masked secrets back from the vault and moves `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` and `node_modules` over. It works without dsh: it uses Node.js, or the DeepSeek Harness app itself. On a new computer, copy the folder of **For another computer** and open `Composer Plus Rescue` there.
how.zh: 每次备份还会把救援控制台放进备份文件夹。当 dsh 已关闭或无法启动时，在该文件夹中打开 `Composer Plus Rescue`（macOS：`Composer Plus Rescue.command`）：终端窗口中的菜单可以列出、检查和恢复备份，以及检查和修复会话日志。它不打开网络端口。恢复时需要输入 `RESTORE`，会把当前的 dsh 主目录保留为 `.dsh.pre-restore-<时间>`，从 vault 放回被遮蔽的机密，并把 `cache/`、`dsh-runtimes/` 和 `node_modules` 移过来。它不需要 dsh：它使用 Node.js，或 DeepSeek Harness 应用本身。在新电脑上，复制 **用于另一台电脑** 生成的文件夹并在那里打开 `Composer Plus Rescue`。
how.tr: Her yedekleme, yedek klasörüne bir kurtarma konsolu da koyar. dsh kapalıyken ya da açılmadığında bu klasörde `Composer Plus Rescue` dosyasını açın (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): bir terminal penceresindeki menü yedekleri listeler, kontrol eder ve geri yükler, oturum günlüklerini de kontrol edip onarır. Ağ portu açmaz. Geri yükleme sizden `RESTORE` yazmanızı ister, mevcut dsh ana klasörünüzü `.dsh.pre-restore-<zaman>` olarak saklar, maskelenmiş gizli bilgileri vault’tan geri koyar ve `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` ile `node_modules` klasörlerini eski klasörden taşır. dsh olmadan çalışır: Node.js’i ya da DeepSeek Harness uygulamasının kendisini kullanır. Yeni bir bilgisayarda **Başka bir bilgisayar için** ile hazırlanan klasörü kopyalayın ve `Composer Plus Rescue` dosyasını orada açın.
how.es: Cada copia de seguridad también pone una consola de rescate en la carpeta de copias de seguridad. Cuando dsh está cerrado o no se inicia, abre `Composer Plus Rescue` en esa carpeta (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): un menú en una ventana de terminal muestra, comprueba y restaura copias de seguridad, y comprueba y repara registros de sesión. No abre ningún puerto de red. Una restauración te pide escribir `RESTORE`, conserva tu directorio home de dsh actual como `.dsh.pre-restore-<hora>`, vuelve a poner los secretos ocultos desde el vault y trae `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` y `node_modules` del directorio anterior. Funciona sin dsh: usa Node.js o la propia app DeepSeek Harness. En un equipo nuevo, copia la carpeta de **Para otro equipo** y abre `Composer Plus Rescue` allí.
how.pt-BR: Cada backup também coloca um console de resgate na pasta de backups. Quando o dsh está fechado ou não inicia, abra `Composer Plus Rescue` nessa pasta (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): um menu em uma janela de terminal lista, verifica e restaura backups, e verifica e repara logs de sessão. Ele não abre nenhuma porta de rede. Uma restauração pede que você digite `RESTORE`, mantém sua pasta home do dsh atual como `.dsh.pre-restore-<hora>`, coloca de volta os segredos mascarados a partir do vault e traz `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` e `node_modules` da pasta antiga. Ele funciona sem o dsh: usa o Node.js ou o próprio app DeepSeek Harness. Em um computador novo, copie a pasta de **Para outro computador** e abra `Composer Plus Rescue` lá.
how.fr: Chaque sauvegarde place aussi une console de secours dans le dossier de sauvegarde. Quand dsh est fermé ou ne démarre pas, ouvrez `Composer Plus Rescue` dans ce dossier (macOS : `Composer Plus Rescue.command`) : un menu dans une fenêtre de terminal liste, vérifie et restaure les sauvegardes, et vérifie et répare les journaux de session. Elle n’ouvre aucun port réseau. Une restauration vous demande de taper `RESTORE`, garde votre dossier personnel de dsh actuel sous le nom `.dsh.pre-restore-<heure>`, remet les secrets masqués depuis le vault et déplace `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` et `node_modules` depuis l’ancien dossier. Elle fonctionne sans dsh : elle utilise Node.js, ou l’app DeepSeek Harness elle-même. Sur un nouvel ordinateur, copiez le dossier de **Pour un autre ordinateur** et ouvrez `Composer Plus Rescue` à cet endroit.
how.de: Jede Sicherung legt auch eine Rettungskonsole in den Sicherungsordner. Wenn dsh geschlossen ist oder nicht startet, öffne `Composer Plus Rescue` in diesem Ordner (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): Ein Menü in einem Terminalfenster listet Sicherungen auf, prüft sie und stellt sie wieder her, und es prüft und repariert Sitzungsprotokolle. Sie öffnet keinen Netzwerkport. Eine Wiederherstellung bittet dich, `RESTORE` einzugeben, behält dein aktuelles dsh-Home als `.dsh.pre-restore-<Zeit>`, legt die maskierten Geheimnisse aus dem vault zurück und verschiebt `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` und `node_modules` aus dem alten Ordner. Sie funktioniert ohne dsh: Sie nutzt Node.js oder die App DeepSeek Harness selbst. Auf einem neuen Computer kopierst du den Ordner von **Für einen anderen Computer** und öffnest dort `Composer Plus Rescue`.
how.ru: Каждая резервная копия также кладёт аварийную консоль в папку резервных копий. Когда dsh закрыт или не запускается, откройте `Composer Plus Rescue` в этой папке (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): меню в окне терминала показывает, проверяет и восстанавливает резервные копии, а также проверяет и исправляет журналы сеансов. Консоль не открывает сетевой порт. При восстановлении нужно ввести `RESTORE`; текущая домашняя папка dsh сохраняется как `.dsh.pre-restore-<время>`, скрытые секреты возвращаются из vault, а `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` и `node_modules` переносятся из старой папки. Консоль работает без dsh: она использует Node.js или само приложение DeepSeek Harness. На новом компьютере скопируйте папку из **Для другого компьютера** и откройте там `Composer Plus Rescue`.
how.ja: バックアップのたびに、バックアップフォルダーにレスキューコンソールも置かれます。dsh が閉じているときや起動しないときは、そのフォルダーで `Composer Plus Rescue` を開きます（macOS：`Composer Plus Rescue.command`）。ターミナルウィンドウのメニューで、バックアップの一覧表示、チェック、復元と、セッションログのチェック、修復ができます。ネットワークポートは開きません。復元では `RESTORE` の入力を求め、現在の dsh のホームを `.dsh.pre-restore-<時刻>` として残し、マスクされたシークレットを vault から戻し、`cache/`、`dsh-runtimes/`、`node_modules` を古いフォルダーから移します。dsh がなくても動きます。Node.js か、DeepSeek Harness アプリ自体を使います。新しいコンピュータでは、**別のコンピュータ用** のフォルダーをコピーし、そこで `Composer Plus Rescue` を開きます。
how.ko: 백업할 때마다 백업 폴더에 복구 콘솔도 넣습니다. dsh가 닫혀 있거나 시작되지 않으면 그 폴더에서 `Composer Plus Rescue`를 여세요(macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`). 터미널 창의 메뉴에서 백업을 나열, 검사, 복원하고 세션 로그를 검사, 복구할 수 있습니다. 네트워크 포트를 열지 않습니다. 복원할 때는 `RESTORE`를 입력해야 하며, 현재 dsh 홈을 `.dsh.pre-restore-<시각>`으로 남기고, 마스킹된 비밀 값을 vault에서 되돌려 놓고, `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/`, `node_modules`를 이전 폴더에서 옮겨 옵니다. dsh 없이도 작동합니다. Node.js나 DeepSeek Harness 앱 자체를 사용합니다. 새 컴퓨터에서는 **다른 컴퓨터용** 폴더를 복사하고 그곳에서 `Composer Plus Rescue`를 여세요.
how.id: Setiap pencadangan juga menaruh konsol penyelamat di folder cadangan. Saat dsh ditutup atau tidak dapat dimulai, buka `Composer Plus Rescue` di folder itu (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): menu di jendela terminal menampilkan, memeriksa, dan memulihkan cadangan, serta memeriksa dan memperbaiki log sesi. Konsol ini tidak membuka port jaringan. Pemulihan meminta Anda mengetik `RESTORE`, menyimpan dsh home Anda saat ini sebagai `.dsh.pre-restore-<waktu>`, mengembalikan rahasia yang disamarkan dari vault, dan memindahkan `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/`, dan `node_modules` dari folder lama. Konsol ini bekerja tanpa dsh: konsol memakai Node.js, atau aplikasi DeepSeek Harness itu sendiri. Di komputer baru, salin folder dari **Untuk komputer lain** dan buka `Composer Plus Rescue` di sana.
how.vi: Mỗi lần sao lưu cũng đặt một bảng điều khiển cứu hộ vào thư mục sao lưu. Khi dsh đã đóng hoặc không khởi động được, hãy mở `Composer Plus Rescue` trong thư mục đó (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): một menu trong cửa sổ terminal liệt kê, kiểm tra và khôi phục bản sao lưu, đồng thời kiểm tra và sửa nhật ký phiên. Nó không mở cổng mạng nào. Khi khôi phục, bạn phải gõ `RESTORE`; thư mục home hiện tại của dsh được giữ lại dưới tên `.dsh.pre-restore-<thời gian>`, các thông tin bí mật đã che được đưa trở lại từ vault, và `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` và `node_modules` được chuyển sang từ thư mục cũ. Nó chạy được mà không cần dsh: nó dùng Node.js, hoặc chính ứng dụng DeepSeek Harness. Trên máy tính mới, hãy sao chép thư mục của **Cho máy tính khác** và mở `Composer Plus Rescue` ở đó.
how.hi: हर बैकअप, बैकअप फ़ोल्डर में एक रेस्क्यू कंसोल भी रखता है। जब dsh बंद हो या शुरू न हो, तो उस फ़ोल्डर में `Composer Plus Rescue` खोलें (macOS: `Composer Plus Rescue.command`): टर्मिनल विंडो में एक मेन्यू बैकअप की सूची दिखाता है, उन्हें जांचता और बहाल करता है, और सेशन लॉग जांचता और ठीक करता है। यह कोई नेटवर्क पोर्ट नहीं खोलता। बहाली के समय आपको `RESTORE` टाइप करना होता है; यह आपके मौजूदा dsh होम को `.dsh.pre-restore-<समय>` के रूप में रखता है, मास्क किए गए सीक्रेट vault से वापस रखता है और `cache/`, `dsh-runtimes/` और `node_modules` को पुराने फ़ोल्डर से ले आता है। यह dsh के बिना काम करता है: यह Node.js या खुद DeepSeek Harness ऐप का उपयोग करता है। नए कंप्यूटर पर **दूसरे कंप्यूटर के लिए** वाला फ़ोल्डर कॉपी करें और वहां `Composer Plus Rescue` खोलें।

request.POST: `{sessionId, afterSeq}`: continue the last stopped, failed or cut-off turn without a chat message.

request.GET: `?sessionId&mode=uncommitted|unstaged|staged|branch|commit|chat|pending` (`&commit=<full id>` with `commit`; `&ref=<branch ref>&target=<branch ref>` with `pending`: the files that `ref` brings into `target`, from their merge base; `&ws=1` hides whitespace-only changes): the changed files of the chat's folder, of one commit, of one branch against its target or (`chat`) of the files that the chat's tools wrote (read-only git) and the newest turn for Last Turn.
`?sessionId&mode&path` (`&commit=<full id>` with `mode=commit`, `&ref&target` with `mode=pending`, `&ws=1`): the diff of one changed file.
`?sessionId&path` (`path` from the repository top): the chats of the same repository whose write/edit tools changed that file, one row per request, newest first (read from the chat logs only).

`?sessionId`: the branch map of the chat's folder: the branches (the current branch or a detached HEAD first, then local, then remote ones without a local branch of the same name; at most 60), the main branch, and for each branch its state (`main`, `merged`, `waiting`), whether the main branch has its work, its target branch, the merge commit that took it and its row on the map (read from the newest 20,000 commits; `partial` when the history is longer). `&ref=refs/heads/…`, `refs/remotes/…` or `HEAD`: that branch's newest 300 commits (first-parent line) with their refs, 404 when the branch is gone. Read-only git; also the newest turn for Last Turn.
`?id=<shot>`: one shipped Settings screenshot (`SHOTS` in index.js only).
No query: the latest GitHub release compared with this copy (`latest`, `newer`, `managed`, `url`, `notes`); calls GitHub and npm. `?current=1`: only the running version (What's new), no network call.
The grants that still run, `{ [sessionId]: [tool] }`. `?detail=1`: `{ttlMs, grants: { [sessionId]: { [tool]: msLeft | null } }}` with the time limit.
request.POST: `{action: "grant", sessionId, tool}` or `{action: "revoke", sessionId}`, or `{ttlMs}` (Settings only: 15 min, 1 h, 4 h, 8 h or `null` = until revoked). `?detail=1` answers the detailed form.

request.GET: The switch and the gateway state.
request.POST: `{on}`: switch the gateway on or off (a switch route).

request.GET: `{unread: [sessionId]}`: Tether's green dots, the chats that finished and that no device opened yet (empty while Mobile connect is off).
request.POST: `{sessionIds}` (1–1000 ids): these chats are read; answers the new `{unread}` and tells the phones.
`{sessionId, itemId, to, before}`: move one queued message in dsh's queue.

`{sessionId, itemId, content, seen?}`: give one of your own queued messages new text, images and files (kept attachments by `attachmentId`, a new image as bytes, a new file by its upload `receiptId`); the message keeps its id and its place.

request.GET: The switch `{on}`.
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (a switch route).

request.GET: `{on, branches: { [sessionId]: branch }}`: the git branch of each chat's folder at its last turn (none while off).
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (Settings only; the phone gateway refuses it).

request.GET: No query: the switch `{on}`. `?sessionId`: the withdrawn spans, whether dsh-rewind-plugin owns rollback, and the rollback that Redo can take back (`redo`).
request.POST: `{on}` (the switch), `{sessionId, seq, preview?, files?}`: list or take back the turns from that message, with the files when `files` is true, or `{sessionId, redo, preview?, files?, overwrite?}`: list or redo that rollback in a new chat (a fork), with the files.
`{sessionId}`: stop the chat and move its log folders, with its subagent chats, to the Trash.

request.GET: The switch `{on, active}`.
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (a switch route; applies after a dsh restart).
`{sessionId, locale?, focus?}`: suggest ideas (one model call), or `{sessionId, idea, plan?}`: start a chat for one idea.

request.GET: `?sessionId`: the earlier ideas of the chat's project.
request.POST: `{sessionId, remove}` or `{sessionId, clear: true}`: forget one or all.

request.GET: `?sessionId`: the Later list of the chat's project.
request.POST: `{sessionId, add | remove | start | startAll | issue, plan?}`: change the list, start chats for its ideas, or (`issue: <id>`) open a GitHub issue for one idea with the user's `gh` and keep its link.

request.GET: The switch `{on}`.
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (a switch route).

request.GET: The switch and the model; `?catalog=1` adds dsh's model list.
request.POST: `{sessionId, afterSeq}`: the guess for that finished turn (one model call), or `{on}` / `{model}` (Settings only).

request.GET: The switch and the model; `?catalog=1` adds dsh's model list and the prediction's model.
request.POST: `{sessionId, text}`: the rest of the typed message (one model call), or `{on}` / `{model}` (Settings only).

request.GET: The saved model; `?catalog=1` adds dsh's model list.
request.POST: `{sessionId, text}`: the improved prompt for that draft (one model call, read-only), or `{model}` (Settings only).

request.GET: The switch and the verifier's model; `?catalog=1` adds dsh's model list; `?sessionId=` gives that chat's row: own check, found test, last result, running, goal phase and budget use.
request.POST: `{sessionId, check}` saves the chat's test command and limits (`null` removes them); `{sessionId, run: true}` runs the check now (it does not close the goal); `{on}` / `{model}` (Settings only).

`{sessionId}`: a handoff note from the chat (one model call, read-only); `{sessionId, note, start: true}`: a new chat in the same project with the note and a link to the old chat as its first message (a failed send archives the new chat). A newer note replaces a running one (the older answers 409); a start is refused while a note or another start runs (409).

request.GET: `?sessionId`: what fills the chat's model context now, by part, with estimated tokens and the context window (read-only, from the chat log).
The switch, the patterns and the defaults.
request.POST: `{patterns: [{pattern, mode: all|write}]}` saves the list; `{on}` (Settings only).

request.GET: The switch `{on}`.
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (a switch route).

request.GET: Every saved note: `{projects: [{id, name, path, count, files}], global, busy}`; 409 while the switch is off.
request.POST: `{preview: {project: <id> | 'global' | null, text}}`: the changes that dsh's default model proposes (nothing is written), or `{apply: <id>}`: writes all the changes of that preview or none, only while the notes are unchanged (409 when they changed or a change is refused, for example a full MEMORY.md; 500 on a write error; 410 when it is gone). One at a time (409 busy).

request.GET: `?sessionId`: the chat's messages for the Markdown export (read-only, from the chat log).
No query: the switch `{on}`. `?sessionId` (`&list=1` adds the open worktrees): the chat's repository, branch, upstream, ahead/behind, change count and `hasCommit` (read-only git).
request.POST: `{on}` (the switch; off, the route starts and opens nothing, and a chat whose branch folder is gone is not moved), `{action:'start', sessionId, text, attachments?, plan?}`: name a branch from the text (one model call; with no text, the dated name `feat/chat-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMM>` and no model call), add a worktree in `<project>/.worktrees/`, copy the `.worktreeinclude` files and start a new chat there with the text and the attachments. `attachments` are dsh's prompt parts: `{type:'image', mediaType, data, name?}` is sent as it is, and `{type:'file', receiptId}` is an upload of the source chat, which is stored again for the new chat. `text` can be empty when the request gives attachments. With `plan: true`, or when the source chat is in plan mode, the new chat runs dsh's `/plan` before the message (409 when this dsh has no commands service; no message when `/plan` fails); `{action:'open', sessionId, path}`: add one of the repository's worktrees as a project.

request.GET: `{on}`: the switch. `?moved=<sessionId>`: also `moved`, the copy of that chat when it moved into its branch (the browser opens it).
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch (Settings only; the phone gateway refuses it). `{sync: true}`: check the tree now, `{on, added, removed}` (the project paths added and removed).

request.GET: `{on, workspaceId?, gone?, available, general: {path, workspaceId?}}`: the switch, the chosen project (`gone` when dsh no longer has it) and dsh's general folder.
request.POST: `{on}`: the switch; `{workspaceId}`: the project that the global New session opens (`null` = the general folder; an unknown project gets 409). Settings only; the phone gateway refuses it.

`{}`: the workspace that the global New session opens, `{workspaceId, path, title, general}`: the chosen project, else the general folder (made and added as a project at the first use); 409 while the switch is off.

request.GET: The backup folder, its archives (newest first: name, kind, time, size, checksum file, masked count), the running action with its progress, the last result and the last session log check.
request.POST: `{action:'backup', kind?:'backup'|'pre-upgrade'}`, `{action:'verify', name}`, `{action:'transfer', name}`, `{action:'delete', name}`, `{action:'scan'}`, `{action:'repair'}` (sessionDoctor), `{action:'cancel'}`, `{action:'reveal'}`. One action at a time: 409 while another runs here or in the rescue console. `name` must be an archive name, never a path. Long actions answer at once with the state; read it again.

request.GET: `{on, hours, keep, next?, failed?}`.
request.POST: `{on}`, `{hours}` (6, 12, 24, 72 or 168) or `{keep}` (3, 5, 7 or 14), one at a time. Settings only.

request.GET: `{on, folder, files}`: the switch and the console files that are in the backup folder now.
request.POST: `{on}`: off removes the files; on writes them when the folder exists. Settings only.
